media_work.title: Serpico
media_work.focus_or_theme: Police corruption in NYPD, whistleblowing, integrity vs. systemic pressure.
media_work.summaryNotes: Based on the real-life story of NYPD detective Frank Serpico.

media_item.focus_or_theme: Police corruption in NYPD, whistleblowing, integrity vs. systemic pressure.
media_item.summary_notes: The film tells the true story of Frank Serpico's efforts to expose corruption within the NYPD in the 1960s and 70s. While it indicts police misconduct, the narrative centers on Serpico's personal battle rather than specific wrongful convictions.

research_notes_other.notes_from_film_list.txt: Themes include police corruption, integrity in law enforcement. Available via Hulu, Amazon.
research_notes_other.research_findings: This classic film directed by Sidney Lumettells the true story of Frank Serpico's dangerous efforts to expose corruption within the NYPD in the 1960s and 70s. While a powerful indictment of police misconduct, its narrative centers on Serpico's personal battle rather than the specific downstream consequences like wrongful convictions.
